conditions: The DD * statement has no DLM and is used outside the separately documented APPC case.
limitations: DD DATA and DD with DLM use different delimiter rules. Contents between the boundaries are data for the job-step consumer. Utility commands, TSO commands, their grammar and their operation are separate.

triggers: Publisher correction, exact edition or integrity discrepancy, or contrary JCL language evidence.

statement: Outside an APPC scheduling environment, the February 2025 reference describes DD * without DLM as starting an in-stream data set immediately after the statement. The data ends at the default /* delimiter, the // introducing another JCL statement, or the end of the input.
